thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: prod-api-high-latency — threshold breached (p95 > 1.2s) in us-west-2. Paging policy: SEV-2. Please acknowledge.

lia: acked. I’m oncall — looking now. Any customer tickets?

omar: I’m seeing elevated 500s from the /v1/generate route in the last 3 minutes. Rate spiked by 2.4x. No known deploys in the last 30m.

raj: rolling check: CPU on gpu-pool-3 is fine, but latency on the inference-proxy boxes is increased. Could be batching backlog. Pulling traces.

maya: customer-impact: Zendesk shows 4 new tickets in the last 10m referencing timeouts. Two from a single enterprise customer (ACME).

lia: timeline so far:
- 1966001200 approx: small traffic bump from marketing campaign (confirmed by traffic spike dashboard)
- 1966001220: first error rate increase on /v1/generate
- 1966001234: pager fired (this thread)

omar: logs (recent tail):
```
2026-03-15T14:00:20Z inf proxy request id=abc123 route=/v1/generate backend=rg-1 status=200 duration_ms=180
2026-03-15T14:01:05Z err proxy request id=abc456 route=/v1/generate backend=rg-2 status=502 duration_ms=300
2026-03-15T14:01:18Z err proxy request id=abc789 route=/v1/generate backend=rg-2 status=504 duration_ms=1200
```

lia: hypothesis 1: backend model host rg-2 is overloaded or firing transient OOMs -> 502/504. Hypothesis 2: increased batching delays at proxy due to traffic pattern causing timeouts.

sre-oncall: quick checks:
- No infra deploys in last hour (deploy-bot ok)
- Autoscaler for rg-2 pool has not triggered scaling; min replicas set to 2, current 2.

raj: I’m running an ad-hoc query against logs to see missing spans and sampling flags. Query (ELK):
```
index=proxy-logs text:"/v1/generate" | where status>=500 | stats count() by backend, status
```
Result: rg-2 shows 37 errors (502/504) in last 10m, rg-1 shows 3.

maya: dashboards: the p95 latency heatmap has a sudden vertical band at 14:01PT. The dashboard threshold alert was set to p95>1.2s but sampling in the dashboard was accidentally set to 10% for that panel (weirdly). That may have hidden earlier trends.

lia: important observability gap: the proxy request logs are sampled at different rates across regions. us-west has sampling=1 (full), eu-west has sampling=0.1. Need to standardize or at least flag this during incidents. Putting that in the timeline.

omar: adding raw stack traces from one 502 backend response (scrubbed):
```
error: upstream connection reset
trace: at kServe.cpp:124
mem: available 1.2GB
```
Not a clear OOM, more like connection resets.

lia: mitigation actions:
1) Fail open: add temporary routing rule to shift 30% of traffic from rg-2 -> rg-1 (compat variant) for next 15m.
2) Increase replica count for rg-2 from 2 -> 4 (manual scale) while we observe.
3) Lower proxy batching window to 20ms to reduce queuing-induced tail latency.

raj: executing scale now: `kubectl scale deployment rg-2 --replicas=4 -n prod` -> started at 1966001245.

sre-oncall: note on batched requests: reducing batch window may increase cost (less token coalescing) but will reduce p95. Confirming with product that temporary cost is acceptable.

maya: I’ll reach out to ACME support contact with a brief heads up: we’ve seen elevated errors, mitigation in progress, ETA 15-30m.

omar: after routing 30% -> rg-1 (started 1966001250): error rate on rg-2 dropped but overall errors decreased by ~65%. Still some 504s.

lia: current state at 1966001260: p95 down from 1.5s -> 900ms, error rate down but not fully resolved. Keeping paging open until stable for 15m.

raj: digging into observability gaps:
- some proxy instances were running an older logging config that omitted upstream connection resets (we found two instances with old image tag proxy:v1.3.1).
- sampling config drift: changes applied during a previous experiment were not reverted.

lia: action items for post-incident RCA (tracking here):
- Collect complete logs from all proxy instances (including ones with older image tag) and add to shared S3 bucket. Command: `logship collect --filter proxy --from 1966001180 --to 1966001290 --out s3://redwood-incident-1966001234/`
- Audit sampling configs across regions and dashboards; propose standard sampling policy.
- Add a dashboard panel showing per-backend error counts (unsampled) with real-time alerts.
- Run a canary traffic replay for rg-2 under controlled load to reproduce connection resets.

maya: customer comms draft pinned to the thread: "We experienced elevated errors impacting some requests to the Redwood API in us-west-2. We rerouted traffic and increased capacity; errors are reduced. We are collecting logs and will follow up with a root cause within 48 hours. Apologies for the disruption."

omar: note: while collecting logs we found that our log retention policy had a 1-hour hot index roll which occasionally drops the most recent 30s of logs during index switch. That likely created small gaps right at the incident start — another observability gap.

lia: for live RCA, please paste any queries, traces, or raw snippets here. I’ll maintain the timeline and hypotheses.

raj: adding hypothesis 3: network flapping between proxy and backend due to concurrent GC cycles on a particular host type. Need kernel and NIC driver metrics from those hosts.

sre-oncall: mitigation update 1966001285: scaling finished, traffic shift still in place, observed steady p95 ~880ms and customer tickets paused. Keeping monitoring for 15m.

lia: thanks team. After 15m stable window we’ll close the pager and open a post-incident channel for RCA writeup. For now tagging owners: logs: omar, sampling audit: maya, canary/repro: raj.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Acknowledged. Pager status: acknowledged by lia. Escalation window active until 1966002185.

omar: uploading collected logs to s3://redwood-incident-1966001234/finished.log.gz (link: https://s3.redwood/internal/redwood-incident-1966001234/finished.log.gz)

lia: closing live thread summary for handoff at 1966001290: mitigation applied, p95 improving, action items logged. Will start RCA doc in #incidents-rca and paste link here when ready.

maya: ack, will draft sampling policy PR after RCA.
